evals.prompt: Create a migration for a new orders table — project uses Flyway
expect: detects Flyway from db/migration/ or flyway-core
names the file V<n>__create_orders_table.sql with the next version number
includes a version column and created_at/updated_at audit columns

evals.prompt: Add a db migration in a Liquibase project
expect: detects Liquibase from db/changelog/ or liquibase-core
generates a changeSet with a unique incrementing id and author
does not produce a Flyway .sql file

evals.prompt: Create a migration — existing migrations go up to V7
expect: does not reuse V7 or an earlier number

evals.prompt: Generate a migration for a project with no migration tool configured
expect: notes the dependency the project must add

evals.prompt: I just scaffolded an Account entity with @Version and audit fields — generate the matching migration
expect: the DDL includes the version column and created_at/updated_at
reminds to commit entity + migration together

evals.prompt: Edit the already-applied V3 migration to add a column
expect: refuses to edit an applied migration
creates a new migration (V<next>) with an ALTER instead
